description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RequestForwardableException' used within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends the base Exception class and implements HttpExceptionInterface to facilitate request forwarding logic with additional context such as controller, attributes, query parameters, and response details.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
classes.description: A custom exception class that encapsulates request forwarding details, including controller, attributes, query parameters, status code, and headers. Implements HttpExceptionInterface to be compatible with Symfony HTTP kernel exception handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the exception with specified controller, attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: setController
methods.description: Sets the controller for the exception.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the exception.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the exception.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query parameters associated with the exception.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query parameters for the exception.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for the response.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the response.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the response.
